motivation.primary_continuity_reason: R15 is retained as the continuity endpoint because the earlier Macro Event V2 preregistration froze a 15-minute reaction window before its results were observed. V1.50 development also shows positive R15 direction without changing that historical window.

eligibility.rule: Every future governed event in an eligible family is logged. A directional trial is eligible only when a non-zero Macro Event score is successfully frozen after the release and before the corresponding prospective target matures.
eligibility.source_failure_is_not_a_miss_or_hit: Source/clock failures are reported separately and count against coverage; they may not be silently dropped.

prediction_clock.score_origin: First immutable Macro Event score snapshot whose retrieved_at/available_as_of is at or after the official release time. No timestamp may be backdated.

PRIMARY_POST_SCORE_15M.p0: Close of the first completed contiguous Twelve Data XAU/USD 1-minute bar completed after the frozen score_origin timestamp.
PRIMARY_POST_SCORE_15M.p15: Close after 15 further completed contiguous 1-minute bars from p0.

SECONDARY_EVENT_R5.window: official release: pre-release completed minute to first 5 completed minutes

SECONDARY_EVENT_R15.role: announcement-reaction continuity diagnostic only; not relabelled as live pre-release forecast
SECONDARY_EVENT_R15.window: official release: pre-release completed minute to first 15 completed minutes

SECONDARY_EVENT_R30.window: official release: pre-release completed minute to first 30 completed minutes

SEPARATE_CONTINUATION_NEXT_NY17.role: separate continuation endpoint; never pooled with initial reaction
SEPARATE_CONTINUATION_NEXT_NY17.target: first governed NY17 observation after the event date

strong_state_subgroup.threshold_rule: Existing frozen state definition only. No threshold may be selected or lowered from 2023-2026 observed outcomes.

market_shock_confirmation.rule: A Market Shock state may be attached only after its required price bars are observable. It cannot be back-propagated to the release-time Macro Event prediction.

primary_evaluation.failure_rule: Failure at the frozen n=30 checkpoint closes this identity for promotion. Any substantive redesign requires a new successor identity frozen before new outcomes.

required: R5/R15/R30 announcement-reaction hit rate and signed return
Market Shock overlap and sign concordance
